a11y: A real nav landmark of links; group buttons carry aria-expanded and the sub-list is plain links. In the rail the label is hidden visually, never removed — keep it in the markup and add a title so the icon still has a name.
description: The app sidebar as a part: sections, collapsible groups, badges, an icon rail variant, and the user at the foot.
title: Sidebar
usage: Drop it at the left edge of an app frame. The current page is marked by the vermillion core on its icon — the same mark the App Shell block and the templates use. Groups collapse with the small script; without the script they stay exactly as written, so write the important one open.
